declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Ostrander Bell LLP supports preliminary approval of the settlement. The parties reached agreement through arm’s-length negotiations over the amount and delivery of class relief and the proposed attorneys’ fees. Fees were included in the parties’ proposals from the outset; they were not negotiated only after class relief was agreed. The resulting settlement provides a $28.5 million class fund for automatic payments to identified members, without a claims process. The separate $2 million fee request remains subject to court approval; Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing it, and any amount not awarded will go to the class. In counsel’s judgment, the certain, automatic recovery is fair to the class in light of litigation risks, including class certification, and the time required to reach trial.
